text:
maya: Heads up - I've been seeing a ~12h hole in the hourly telemetry aggregates for us-east-1 (03:00-15:00 UTC). Looks like a late-event cascade from the ingest retry backlog.
liam: Which aggregate? hourly_count or agg-hours?
maya: hourly_count. root cause seems to be a burst of retries that hit the ingestion partition and then got deduped irregularly.
ben: Any PII/dup concerns if we rehydrate?
maya: No PII, but there are duplicates across multiple event ids. We need a dedupe-safe replay.
sasha: Console quotas are tight this week - running a big rehydrate will trip the reserved slot budget. Can we split into micro-slices? :thinking_face:
liam: micro-slices + low-priority routing sounds right. We already have the priority-lane flag on the replay API.
devex-eric: UX note: the console currently shows a single progress bar for replays - if we segment we should show per-slice progress or folks will cancel mid-run.
ben: Agreed. Also make sure the replay uses "--idempotent=true" and the de-dup window = 48h.
maya: Proposed plan: 1) run a dry-run with 1 hour slice to verify dedupe; 2) route slices to priority=low and stagger at 10m intervals; 3) monitor aggregate diffs on dashboard.
liam: For dry-run, can you paste the exact curl?
maya: Sure -

# dry-run 1h slice
curl -X POST "https://internal-api/replay" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REPLAY_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"start":"2024-05-10T03:00:00Z","end":"2024-05-10T04:00:00Z","dry_run":true,"priority":"low","idempotent":true}'

sasha: If console quota blocks the POST, we can fallback to replay-bot which uses reserved tokens for operator runs. replay-bot: any objections?
replay-bot: automated: current reserved tokens available = 12. Suggested max concurrent slices = 6.
ben: Cool. Set max_concurrent=4 to be safe.
liam: Add alert in telemetry dashboard to compare pre/post hourly_count diffs > 1% for more than 3 consecutive hours. If hit, pause.
devex-eric: I can add a temporary badge in the console that links to the dry-run results and shows dedupe hits. Small UX but high signal.
maya: I'll kick off the dry-run in ~5m and post results here.
liam: Thanks - and postfix: let's capture replay request_id so we can trace logs across ingestion and compute.
maya: noted. request_id = will paste after start.
replay-bot: automated: dry-run started (id=rb-1705009999-dry). ETA ~2m.
maya: dry-run finished - zero dup collisions reported, sample diff on dashboard shows +0.8% (expected). Will start staged slices at +10m.
sasha: I'll monitor quota dashboard and ping infra if we creep above threshold. :thumbsup:
ben: tagging @oncall just in case, but looks safe.
liam: Postmortem/notes: add small section in replay runbook about micro-slices + console visibility. devex-eric can take a follow-up.
devex-eric: Got it, will add a short doc and console badge before the full run.
maya: Full run started (id=rb-1705009999-run). Slices 1/12 queued to priority=low. Posting progress updates here.
